answer: Give every agent a basalt-hard foundation: an identity locks 10 POA for 21 days and earns three service attestations over ten days. A second identity from the same wallet pays 25 POA and waits 35 days, a third pays 50 POA and waits 56 days, so each fake costs more capital and idle time than the last. Like boats leaving a jetty, identities that echo the same timing and funding patterns are clustered and audited together; a seven-member panel checks service logs on-chain and slashes escrows lacking distinct work. Honest newcomers pass once, while a sybil farm's bill grows faster than its gains.
